questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safe speed for exiting a highway. In this example, the safe exit speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with black markings. Drivers must follow all rules on regulatory signs. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you about a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake problems or crashes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road ahead is divided. Stay to the right of the median or divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill section is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs control traffic speed and movement. Drivers must obey these rules. This sign means when turning left on a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic before completing your turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm up and swings it upward, it signals riders to increase speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs display traffic laws you must obey. Where this sign is posted, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always let pedestrians cross first. Stay alert for pedestrians at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow diamonds with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign means a steep hill is coming. Be ready to slow down to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed and avoid sudden braking or turns. Keep more distance between your vehicle and the one in front.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals show your intentions when turn signals don't work. A left arm extended straight out to the side means you plan to turn left or change lanes left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location. Do not make a right turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means something is not allowed. U-turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows you the only direction traffic is allowed to move. You must go in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with valid disabled parking permits only.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to stay on the right side to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This hand signal means "follow me." Riders use hand signals to communicate with each other when riding in groups.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back, this signal tells the group to stop. This is an important hand signal for group riding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a school crossing is ahead. Be alert for pedestrians and children in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic may merge from the right. Be prepared to allow merging traffic to enter your lane safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the right lane will end soon. Move to another lane if you are in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a side road ahead. Watch for traffic entering from this side road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
Operators may turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that from this lane, you may turn right or go straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They alert you to conditions and hazards ahead on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves right and then left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to an upcoming T intersection. Be ready to turn left or right, or prepare to stop if needed.
